BiblicalUsage: Hatstsalath is deliverance, a rescue that breaks through, and it appears once, in the most famous sentence in Esther. In Esther 4:14 Mordecai tells her that enlargement and deliverance shall arise to the Jews from another place, and asks who knows whether she has come to the kingdom for such a time as this.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the verse is the hinge of the whole book: deliverance will come, with Esther or without her, and the question is whether she will be part of it.
